question: The sum of all but one of the interior angles of a convex polygon is \(1300^\circ\). Find the measure of the omitted interior angle. (Unit: degrees.)
solution: Each interior angle of a convex polygon is less than \(180^\circ\). Let the number of sides be \(n\). Then \((n-2)\times180\) is greater than 1300 but exceeds 1300 by less than 180, giving \((n-2)\times180=1440\). The required interior angle is \(1440-1300=140^\circ\).
